# tdho_excerpt.pdf — attribution

Pages 1–12 of:

**"The time-dependent quantum harmonic oscillator: a pedagogical approach via
the Lewis-Riesenfeld dynamical invariant method"**
Stanley S. Coelho, Lucas Queiroz, Danilo T. Alves
arXiv:2411.12894v3 [quant-ph], 10 Jun 2025
https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.12894

Licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

This excerpt (introduction through the results/conclusion, cut before the
appendices and references) is used as a CI test fixture: a real,
equation-dense physics document to exercise the PDF→MinerU→LaTeX pipeline in
a way the synthetic probe fixture (`make_probe_epub.py`) can't. It replaces
an earlier local-only fixture that came from a copyrighted source and
couldn't be committed to the repo — see `su3_baseline_latex_snapshot.json`'s
sibling test, `test_pdf_regression.py`.

No modifications were made to the page content; pages 13–24 (appendices,
references) were simply not included.
